name: opencode-usage-monitor
description: OpenCode v2 TUI sidebar plugin that displays API usage quotas for OpenAI, Z.AI (GLM), DeepSeek, and OpenCode Go providers

scripts.build:index: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target bun --format esm --external @opencode/plugin --external @opencode/plugin/tui --external @opencode/theme --external @opentui/core --external @opentui/solid --external solid-js
scripts.build:tui: bun build src/tui.ts --outfile dist/tui.js --target bun --format esm --external @opencode/plugin --external @opencode/plugin/tui --external @opencode/theme --external @opentui/core --external @opentui/solid --external solid-js
scripts.build:types: bun x tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/prune-declarations.mjs
scripts.build:all: bun run clean && bun run build:types && bun run build:index && bun run build:tui
scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'Skipping build -- CI already built dist/'

author: mark <i@mark1708.ru>
